title: Legitimate traveller: normal payment from abroad
description: Anita is at a conference in Dubai. Known phone, residential IP, authenticator 2FA, good biometric, known payee, normal amount, official domain, genuine invoice. Only the country is new. This is the false-positive test: it must be asked to step up, never accused. All context data is simulated.

chat.text: Paying this month's stationery invoice from Zenith while I have a minute.

expected.rationale: A single weak signal (new country) plus a high-impact action. Everything else is reassuring, so the corroboration rule keeps this at step-up. It must not reach the verification workflow.
